summary: CivWorld social platform application with features including posts, likes, polls, pages/groups, Communities tab, and comment system. Focus on fixing and enhancing core social features.
architectural_notes: CivWorld is a social platform (Facebook-like) with posts, likes, polls, pages, groups, and Communities tab
Comment system requires nested replies, likes, edit/delete/report with permission checks, and real-time display without page refresh
known_issues: Comment section is broken — comments cannot be saved or displayed
Poll results not visible after voting
Multiple builds failing due to request size — breaking into smaller chunks required

existing_features.title: Add React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for the comment system: useGetCommentsByPost(postId) fetches comments for a post; useMutationAddComment() calls addComment; useMutationEditComment() calls editComment; useMutationDeleteComment() calls deleteComment; useMutationLikeComment() calls likeComment. All mutation hooks must invalidate the useGetCommentsByPost query on success so comments refresh instantly without a page reload.

Create a new frontend component frontend/src/components/CommentSection.tsx that renders the full comment UI for a given postId. The component must: display a list of comments showing the author's profile image (or a default avatar), username, relative timestamp (e.g., '2m ago'), and comment text; support nested replies rendered indented under their parent comment; show an input field to add a new top-level comment with a loading spinner while posting; show success and error toast messages after submission attempts; display a three-dot (⋮) context menu on each comment with 'Edit' and 'Delete' options visible only to the comment's author, and a 'Report' option visible to other authenticated users; support an inline reply input triggered per-comment; support inline edit mode replacing comment text with an editable input; show like button with count on each comment; use the React Query hooks from REQ-3 for all data operations.

Integrate the CommentSection component into the PostCard component (frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx). Add a collapsible comment section below each post that is shown/hidden when the user clicks a 'Comment' button or icon. Pass the post's id as the postId prop to CommentSection.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix comment section: add/reply/like/delete/edit comments with backend persistence, dynamic fetch, instant display, loading states, and permission-based options
Fix poll results visibility: show vote percentages, total votes, progress bars, highlight selected option, disable re-voting, prevent duplicate votes
Add three-dot menu (edit/delete/report) for posts and comments with report popup (reasons: Spam, Fake News, Abusive Content, Political Misinformation, Other) saved to admin panel
Add structured location/political data fields (District, MP Constituency, MLA Constituency, Mandal, Village) with dependent dropdowns on posts, pages, groups, and user profiles
Admin panel: view/delete reported posts/comments, suspend users
UI improvements: ensure all buttons clickable, fix routing errors, add loading states and toast/snackbar messages

Define a Comment data type in the backend with fields: id (Nat), postId (Text), authorId (Principal), content (Text), createdAt (Int), updatedAt (opt Int), parentCommentId (opt Nat), likes (array of Principal), isDeleted (Bool). Store comments in a stable var array or HashMap keyed by comment id.

Implement the following backend query and update functions for comments: addComment(postId: Text, content: Text, parentCommentId: ?Nat) returns new comment id; getCommentsByPost(postId: Text) returns array of all non-deleted comments for that post; editComment(commentId: Nat, newContent: Text) allows only the comment author to update content; deleteComment(commentId: Nat) marks the comment as deleted (soft delete) only if caller is the author; likeComment(commentId: Nat) toggles the caller's Principal in the comment's likes array; getCommentLikeCount(commentId: Nat) returns the like count.
